identity.name: Village of Indian Creek
identity.notes: Indian Creek is a village, gated community, golf course community, and man-made barrier island in Miami-Dade County, Florida (ZIP 33154). It has 41 residential waterfront home sites and the Indian Creek Country Club, which takes up most of the island. Incorporated May 17, 1939 (founded 1928), it is governed as an incorporated municipality — not a traditional HOA — with its own council–manager government, municipal police department, and Land Development Regulations. Known as "Billionaire Bunker" for its concentration of highly affluent residents; one home sold for $50M in early 2019, the most expensive in Miami-Dade County at the time.

fees.note: No traditional HOA dues: Indian Creek is an incorporated municipality, not a standard HOA. Services are funded primarily via property taxes rather than association dues; specific fee amounts unavailable. (Village office: (305) 865-4121, indiancreekvillagefl.gov; fiscal 2026-27 budget hearings Sept. 8 and Sept. 22.) Land development code violations can be fined up to $500 per day (enforcement, not a recurring fee).

amenities.detail: 18-hole golf course at Indian Creek Country Club, which occupies most of the 300-acre island; ultra-private country club with tightly held membership. One of South Florida's most exclusive neighborhoods.
Old-world Mediterranean-style country club clubhouse designed by architect Maurice Fatio, over 70,000 square feet, with private island setting.
24/7 police presence on land and water (own municipal police department); village has its own government and law enforcement.
Gated community on a private, man-made barrier island with extreme privacy and secluded waterfront estates (41 home sites).
